## Summary
What changed, and why?

## Related work
Link the relevant issue or decision. If there is no related record, say why one is not needed.

## Validation
List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish static checks, simulated tests, and live behavior. Include checks not run and why.

## Review and merge
- [ ] The change is ready for independent review, or this PR remains a draft.
- [ ] A responsible owner and appropriate reviewer are assigned.
- [ ] Labels, a verified assignee, relevant milestone, requested reviewers, linked issues or dependencies, and project fields are current where applicable and supported.

## Risk and information boundaries
Describe operational impact, approvals still required, and any limitations. Confirm no credentials, private keys, personal data, or restricted operational details are included.

Use a concise, descriptive Title Case title without workflow prefixes or ticket identifiers unless repository-specific rules require them.
